# Two runs of one configuration on different hosts: every value except
# times must be bit-identical, and so must every out- key.

exec trainstat repro a.txt b.txt
cmp stdout same.want

# Planted: Train/step=2 grad-norm is one float32 ulp off, and the run
# diverges from there. Same pins, different bits: nondeterministic. Repro
# names step 2, not a later one, and counts the differing values.
! exec trainstat repro a.txt c.txt
cmp stdout diff.want
stderr 'not bit-identical'
[exec:sh] exec sh -c 'trainstat repro a.txt c.txt >/dev/null 2>&1; echo status $?'
[exec:sh] stdout '^status 1$'

# An out- key alone that differs is also nondeterministic.
! exec trainstat repro a.txt g.txt
stdout '^nondeterministic: same configuration, different results$'
stdout '^out-model-sha256: differs \(9f2c vs 0000\)$'
! stdout 'first difference'

# Different bits under a different configuration are reported, but are
# not called nondeterministic.
! exec trainstat repro a.txt h.txt
stdout '^config: differs: mode "lora" != "full"$'
stdout '^first difference: Train/step=2 grad-norm'
! stdout 'nondeterministic'
stdout '^FAIL: not bit-identical$'

# Runs that differ in a pinning key need not agree: refused, naming the key.
! exec trainstat repro a.txt f.txt
stdout '^refused: pinning keys differ: exact \(true vs false\)$'
! stdout 'bit-identical'
stderr 'refused: pinning keys differ'
[exec:sh] exec sh -c 'trainstat repro a.txt f.txt; echo status $?'
[exec:sh] stdout '^status 1$'

# Every differing pinning key is named.
! exec trainstat repro a.txt e.txt
stdout '^refused: pinning keys differ: device \(GB10 vs H100\), exact \(true vs false\)$'

# -pin replaces the list.
exec trainstat repro -pin commit a.txt e.txt
stdout '^config: differs: device "GB10" != "H100"; exact "true" != "false"$'
stdout '^ok: bit-identical$'
! exec trainstat repro -pin commit,device a.txt e.txt
stdout '^refused: pinning keys differ: device \(GB10 vs H100\)$'

# A configuration difference outside the pinning keys is reported but is
# not a failure.
exec trainstat repro a.txt d.txt
stdout '^config: differs: mode "lora" != "full"$'
stdout '^ok: bit-identical$'

# Each input must be one run.
! exec trainstat repro a.txt $TESTDATA/sweep/base.txt
stderr 'base.txt: more than one run'

skipped kind=time: sec/step train-sec

first difference: Train/step=2 grad-norm 0.625 != 0.62500006 (1 float32 ulp)
2 values differ (results: Train 2 of 3)
out-model-sha256: differs (9f2c vs 77e0)
FAIL: not bit-identical
